descriptor: Fixed-Alias Prospective Replay, Cellwise Failure-Probability Calibration, Alias-Conditional Predictive Sufficiency, Stochastic-vs-Representation Variance Separation & Boundary-Law Persistence Test

technical.gptoss120: 1021/1024 OK; minimum 3/4 per cell; shadow disagreement 0
technical.gemini: 1024/1024 OK; minimum 4/4 per cell; shadow disagreement 0

interpretation.gptoss120: No prospective alias-conditioned predictive advantage; alias predictor was worse than vertex-only baseline for both semantics.
interpretation.gemini: Alias-conditioned prediction improved valid-semantic log loss but worsened null-semantic log loss; therefore no two-semantic model-level alias law.
interpretation.variance: For complete Gemini cells, within-cell stochastic variation dominated total sum of squares (valid 0.5360; null 0.6282), while vertex×alias remained nontrivial (valid 0.3037; null 0.2015).
interpretation.calibration: P44 alias-conditioned probabilities were generally overconfident or miscalibrated in P45; no stable calibrated alias law was earned.

authority: Prospective predictive persistence test for exact P44 aliases under frozen contracts. One Gemini valid-semantic signal survived multiplicity correction, but the null twin moved in the opposite predictive direction and neither model satisfied the precommitted two-semantic alias-law gate. This licenses only a partial, model×semantic-specific signal.
